fixture.baseCommitRule: copy the fixture, run docs sync and initial tests, initialize Git, commit every resulting fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm repository evidence distinguishes the independently deployable batch endpoint, request and partial-failure contract, rollout and rollback lifecycle from existing ranking and tracing ownership.
Confirm round one reports one evidence-backed independent-design classification and stops with zero writes, and creation begins only after the exact later approval.

Confirm the new document is draft SPEC-010, allocated after the global maximum in the batch-retrieval Topic, captures the ordered 100-ID partial-failure and rollout contract, and has CLI-generated indexes.
Confirm only one justified Spec and generated indexes are written after approval, with runtime, Architecture, Plan, Tasks, Runs and legacy or suffix-named alternatives unchanged.

hardRejects: writes any project file before the later classification approval
folds the independently deployable batch API into ranking or tracing without lifecycle evidence
reuses an existing or retired Spec ID instead of allocating after the global maximum
creates a non-draft Spec or treats creation approval as Spec acceptance
modifies source, tests, Architecture, Plan, Tasks, or Runs
manually edits generated Index content or writes under hello-scholar/memory
reads the hello-scholar Task Packet, production Skill, or other Eval evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the original request is delivered and no project bytes have changed
the Implementer has reported one evidence-backed classification and stopped without writes
rounds.message: 同意把它归类为独立设计并创建新 Spec。使用全局下一个 ID SPEC-010，在 batch-retrieval Topic 下写 draft spec.md；只用 docs sync 更新生成 Index，不创建 Plan、Tasks、代码或 Run。

criticalPath: Read repository ownership evidence, present an independent-Spec classification, and stop before creation until the hash-bound approval arrives.
